title: Staff Software Engineer - BackEnd (Level 4) | Gurugram, IND
description:
**About Agoda**



At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

  




Today, we are part of Booking Holdings \[NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

  



No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you're ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

  


**About our Team**  

At Agoda, our Backend Engineering team builds **high\-scale, fault\-tolerant distributed systems** that power a global travel platform serving **millions of users daily**. We own mission\-critical domains across **inventory, pricing, booking, payments, and customer/partner platforms**.



Our systems run with **high availability, low latency, and zero\-downtime expectations**, powered by modern technologies such as **Scala, Go, Java, Kotlin, Kafka, and Aerospike**, along with strong foundations in **CI/CD, automation, and observability**.



We ship fast—often **dozens of releases a day**—and design systems that are **resilient, self\-healing, and built to scale globally**.

  

**The Opportunity**  

As a Staff Backend Engineer, you'll own the design and reliability of a critical service or domain end\-to\-end — from architecture through production. Beyond writing code, you'll be expected to identify problems before they're assigned to you, make independent calls on ambiguous technical trade\-offs within your domain, and raise the technical bar for your immediate team. You'll combine hands\-on coding, system design, and technical ownership — accountable for outcomes within your service, and a trusted technical voice when your work touches adjacent teams.

  

**What You will Do**

  


* Design, build, and own scalable distributed systems and microservices within your domain
* Lead development of complex features and technical initiatives end\-to\-end, within your service or team
* Drive system design, API design, and engineering best practices for your team
* Own scalability, performance, reliability, and fault tolerance of the services you're responsible for
* Optimize high\-throughput, low\-latency systems
* Proactively identify gaps, risks, or improvement opportunities in your domain, and drive them to resolution without waiting to be asked
* Make independent architectural and technical trade\-off decisions within your service's scope, and be accountable for the outcomes
* Collaborate with adjacent teams when your service's boundaries or dependencies require it, and raise engineering standards within your own team
* Partner with your product and business stakeholders to translate business needs into technical priorities, and technical constraints into business context
* Stay hands\-on with coding and system design
* Mentor engineers on your team with a structured approach, supporting their growth
* Handle production issues within your domain, drive RCA, and lead follow\-through improvements

  

**What We're Looking For**


*Technical*

  


* 8–12 years of backend engineering experience
* Strong experience building and owning distributed systems at scale, within a service or domain
* Expertise in: Java, Kotlin, Scala, or Go
* Strong understanding of microservices architecture, REST APIs \& system design, SQL/NoSQL databases, and performance, scalability, and concurrency
* Strong coding and problem\-solving ability


*Beyond the technical bar:*

  


* A track record of taking ownership beyond your assigned tasks — initiatives you drove within your domain because you saw the need, not because you were told
* Comfort making decisions under ambiguity and owning the consequences, technical and business, within your area of ownership
* Experience communicating trade\-offs to both engineers and non\-technical stakeholders, adjusting your framing accordingly
* Demonstrated impact mentoring or growing engineers on your team, with concrete outcomes, not just informal help

  



Nice to Have

  


* Experience building large\-scale consumer or marketplace platforms
* Exposure to event\-driven systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ)
* Experience with NoSQL databases (Cassandra, MongoDB, Aerospike)
* Familiarity with cloud (AWS/GCP), CI/CD pipelines
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments

  


###### **\#Delhi \#Gurgaon \#Gurugram \#Bangalore \#Bengaluru \#Chennai \#Noida \#DelhiNCR \#Pune \#Mumbai \#Hyderabad \#Chandigarh \#Kolkata**

#### 


#### **Please review our Hiring Process Guidelines before your interview — click** **here****to learn how interviewing at Agoda works.**

  


### **Discover more about working at Agoda**


* Agoda Careers https://careersatagoda.com
* Facebook https://www.facebook.com/agodacareers/
* LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/agoda
* YouTube https://www.youtube.com/agodalife

  


**Equal Opportunity Employer**



At Agoda, we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds and orientations. We prioritize attracting diverse talent and cultivating an inclusive environment that encourages collaboration and innovation. Employment at Agoda is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity regardless of sex, age, race, color, national origin, religion, marital status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, citizenship, veteran or military status, and other legally protected characteristics.



We will keep your application on file so that we can consider you for future vacancies and you can always ask to have your details removed from the file. For more details please read our privacy policy.


**Disclaimer**



We do not accept any terms or conditions, nor do we recognize any agency's representation of a candidate, from unsolicited third\-party or agency submissions. If we receive unsolicited or speculative CVs, we reserve the right to contact and hire the candidate directly without any obligation to pay a recruitment fee.

title: Technical Lead (E-Commerce)
description:
SynapseIndia is a software development company with over 26 years of experience, featuring development offices in India and the USA. We serve clients worldwide, delivering innovative solutions tailored to their needs. Our Noida SEZ office is conveniently located just a 10\-minute walk from the nearest metro station.


**Why work with us?**


* **Partnerships with Industry Leaders:** We are a Google and Microsoft partner, staffed by certified professionals.
* **Global Presence:** As a multinational corporation, we have clients and employees across the globe.
* **Structured Environment:** We follow CMMI Level\-5 compliant processes to ensure quality and efficiency.
* **Timely Salaries:** We have consistently paid salaries on time since our inception.
* **Job Stability:** Despite market fluctuations, we have not had to lay off employees.
* **Work\-Life Balance:** Enjoy weekends off on the 2nd and last Saturday of every month, with no night shifts.
* Our employees are 100% satisfied, thanks to a culture of trust and growth opportunities.
* **Eco\-Friendly Workplace:** We promote health and well\-being with special anti\-radiation and energy removal features in our offices.
* We prioritize the job security of all our employees.
* We celebrate all festivals with enthusiasm and joy.
* **Yearly Appraisals:** Exceptional performers can receive over 100% increments during appraisals.
* We recognize and reward top performers on a monthly basis for their outstanding contributions.
* We provide Accidental and Medical Insurance to our employees.

  




**Who are we looking for?**


**Designation** : Technical Lead (E\-Commerce)  

**Experience Range :** 6\+ years

  


**What is the work?**


* Lead the design, architecture, development, implementation, and optimization of scalable, secure, and high\-performance e\-commerce platforms.
* Architect and optimize front\-end and back\-end components for robust web applications.
* Work with e\-commerce platforms such as Magento / Adobe Commerce, WooCommerce, Drupal / Drupal Commerce, Shopify / Shopify Plus, PrestaShop, OpenCart, Shopware, and Sylius.
* Provide technical leadership to the development team and establish coding standards, development practices, and architectural guidelines.
* Conduct code reviews and ensure code quality, automated testing, CI, and development standards.
* Collaborate with Business Development, Project Managers, UI/UX designers, developers, and clients to understand requirements and develop technical solutions.
* Participate in client discussions and provide technically feasible, scalable, and commercially viable solutions.
* Review existing client platforms and identify opportunities for enhancements, integrations, performance improvements, feature development, security upgrades, and optimization.
* Identify whether requested changes are within the agreed project scope or require additional effort/change requests.
* Provide technical inputs and estimates for additional work where required.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues involving applications, APIs/integrations, performance, databases, deployments, and production incidents.
* Lead root\-cause analysis and implement sustainable technical solutions.
* Manage deployment of features, enhancements, integrations, and bug fixes with minimal disruption.
* Ensure proper Git, CI/CD, testing, deployment, version control, and rollback processes.
* Evaluate new technologies and recommend solutions that improve performance, scalability, security, functionality, and maintainability.
* Stay updated with developments in e\-commerce platforms, open\-source frameworks, APIs, cloud technologies, security, and development tools.
* Mentor and guide junior and mid\-level developers and conduct knowledge\-sharing sessions.
* Coordinate technical activities to ensure timely project delivery.
* Review technical deliverables and identify risks affecting quality, timelines, scope, or client satisfaction.
* Maintain technical documentation, architecture diagrams, development standards, and project documentation.
* Support Business Development and Project Management teams with solutioning, technical discussions, scope analysis, estimation, and client communication.
* Identify technical gaps and proactively recommend enhancements and additional billable opportunities.
* Contribute to improving the organization's e\-commerce technology capabilities and service offerings.

  




**What skills and experience are we looking for?**

* Strong experience in e\-commerce development and customization.
* Hands\-on experience with Magento, WooCommerce, Drupal, Shopify, PrestaShop, OpenCart, Shopware, Sylius, or similar platforms.
* Strong knowledge of PHP, JavaScript, HTML, CSS, REST APIs, GraphQL, and MySQL/MariaDB.
* Experience with API integrations, payment gateways, ERP/CRM, marketplaces, and e\-commerce integrations.
* Strong understanding of Git, CI/CD, testing, deployment, security, and performance optimization.
* Experience with cloud and containerization technologies such as AWS, Azure, GCP, Docker, or Kubernetes is an advantage.
* Proven experience in technical leadership, team mentoring, and code reviews.
* Strong skills in solution architecture, troubleshooting, estimation, scope management, and requirement analysis.
* Ability to communicate effectively with clients, technical teams, Business Development, and Project Management.
* Strong commercial awareness to identify enhancements and additional billable opportunities.
